up-right.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: eight-frame pixel-art farmer walk sprite sheet.
Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: the current WALK UP-RIGHT 4-column, 2-row sheet. Image 2 is the APPROVED MOTION REFERENCE: WALK DOWN-RIGHT from the same farmer, with reference pose 4 intentionally blank.
Primary request: redraw only BOTH arms and hands in Image 1 using the natural arm swing, changing elbow angles and compact rounded hand shapes of the approved diagonal reference, adapted to the target rear three-quarter up-right facing. Keep the exact target hat, head, rear view, body size, clothing, leg poses and boots. Do not copy the front view or rotate the target to front.
Motion: this is a complete walking cycle, not a set of standing poses. Each arm swings forward then back, smoothly through all 8 frames; the two arms swing opposite each other and opposite their own leg. Study the reference's alternating sleeve/forearm silhouette in poses 1,2,3,5,6,7,8. The elbow must flex naturally as it passes the torso, rather than every forearm staying vertically down. Compact relaxed hands stay attached to their wrists and follow the forearm. Give the farther arm a readable arc as well as the nearer arm, with continuous partial torso occlusion if necessary; never remove the whole arm for a frame or create a spare hand/stump. anatomical right arm is near the viewer on screen-right; anatomical left arm is farther away on screen-left. Keep those anatomical identities throughout the cycle.
Fill output pose 4 by smoothly interpolating the transition 3 to 5, since reference pose 4 is blank. Output ALL EIGHT poses, row-major order, complete 1-8 loop with small 8-to1 transition. Preserve Image 1's phase order and counter-swing relative to its legs.
Style: match the reference's simple crisp pixel clusters, same white sleeves and peach skin, consistent arm lengths and small hands, no isolated fists, no long paddles, no waving or raised elbows. Maintain current farmer proportions and native approximately 64-pixel height. Output 4 equal columns x 2 equal rows on real transparent alpha, with generous transparent gutters and identical pose scale. No text, labels, shadow, ground or background.
up-right.review: Rejected: farther arm remains nearly stationary; near-arm poses1 and5 lack clearly opposite swing.
Rejected: arm sweeps do not clearly match approved alternating reference; several raised poses compress the hand into a fist. Retained as comparison only, not promoted.

up-right.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Pixel-art animation perspective adaptation.
IMAGE 1 is the approved DOWN-RIGHT farmer walk. Recreate THIS approved motion cycle viewed from the opposite rear three-quarter angle, walking UP-RIGHT (away from the camera and toward the right).
IMAGE 2 is ONLY the rear-facing orientation and body-proportion reference. Do NOT duplicate its static arms over the animation. The full eight-frame motion comes from Image 1.
Keep the same farmer: straw hat, reddish hair, short-sleeved white shirt, blue overalls, brown boots, slim proportional build, small relaxed hands, crisp low-resolution pixel clusters. Use Image2 for what the back of the farmer looks like; preserve hat-to-body and boot/leg proportions. Reconstruct the approved pose motion in a rear view rather than rotating flat pixels.
The key task is preserving BOTH anatomical arm trajectories from the approved walk: near arm sweeps from trailing behind the hip at contact1 to forward past the torso at opposite contact5; far arm does the reverse. Turn each whole reference pose spatially, including shoulders, elbows and palms. The arm swing must follow the walking direction, partly across the silhouette and torso, rather than both hands remaining splayed down toward their respective edges. At least1 and5 must show clearly opposite near AND far-arm positions.
Visible sleeve-to-elbow-to-wrist connections; gently relaxed elbows and compact palms, no boxing fists. Far arm has its own motion, gently occluded by torso as it goes forward, reappearing continuously as it trails backward. Do not glue the far hand at hip height in all8poses. No stump popping on and off. No extra arm. An arm cannot teleport across its shoulder or swap anatomical identity.
Build a single coherent complete walk1-8: contact1, recoil2, passing3, rise4, opposite contact5, recoil6, passing7, rise8, then1. Same two legs alternately step, opposite arm follows each leg. Image1 missing pose4 intentionally; interpolate3-to5. Pose8-to1 must continue the arc smoothly.
Output a finished4-column2-row transparent sprite sheet with8distinct full-body poses in sequence. Allcharacterssameapproximately64nativepixelheight, equalcells, wide transparentgutter betweenrows andcolumns. Pixel art at consistent pixel size, no antialiasing or extra tiny texture, no labels, props, shadow, scene or background.
up-right.review: Rejected: rear facing flips from up-right in1-4 to up-left in5-8; far-arm arc still weak; design invariant fails.
